target_customer: Not clear; the company trades its own capital in live markets and presents no customer product
problem: Build a foundation model for quantitative finance that trades autonomously and captures alpha.
business_model: Proprietary trading with an AI research lab framing; no API or subscription presented (per Runtime Wire)

founders.name: Michael Wang
founders.background_notes: Senior researcher at DeepMind and held a Series 57 trader license per company site; education not listed

founders.name: Yuhua Wang
founders.background_notes: Built AI models and agents at Apple and Salesforce's AI platform per YC page; education not listed. The company says the two founders are brothers

competitors.name: Nof1 (Alpha Arena)
competitors.what: AI research lab running live trading contests between frontier models, planning tools for AI trading agents
competitors.traction_then: Season 1 results mostly losses for models

technical_complexity.rationale: Training a model that produces live trading edge is research grade, though a two person team with DeepMind and Jane Street experience can start small. Claims are unverified.

defensibility.rationale: Any edge is a proprietary strategy that decays and is hidden by design; no independent evidence of persistent edge exists.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large quant firms have in-house AI; no action against Prodigy reported.

market_need_then: Reports in May 2026 found most AI trading bots in live tests were losing money, so demand for a model that works is real but unproven. The company's 140 percent return claim is its own and unverified.

identity.logo: Logo and wordmark on company site; not described
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident performance claims, tagline 'Frontier AI for quantitative finance'

branding.brand_signature: Live trading return claim (+140% over the batch, self reported)

rebrands.why: Runtime Wire says the company began as Prodigy AI on prediction market agents and moved to a broader quant model; a USPTO PRODIGY mark is held by another company

branding.community_and_virality: Covered by Runtime Wire with a skeptical angle on the return claim

brand_strength.rationale: The name is a common word with a live conflicting trademark (ExplosionAI, Classes 9 and 42) and social handles use different names; press attention rests on an unverified claim.

pivots.from: Prodigy AI, predictive trading agents for prediction markets
pivots.to: Prodigy Research, foundation model for quantitative finance
pivots.why: not stated; reported by Runtime Wire

outcome_analysis: Prodigy Research is a Summer 2026 YC company with no outcome yet. The founders bring trading desk and frontier AI experience, but its main evidence is a self reported 140 percent return with no method published, so the next test is whether it can show verified performance or raise outside capital.
notes: No funding found; Dealroom lists an unverified $125K seed entry that is not a company or press source. Competitor funding dates were not stated in snippets, so source_date is approximate.
